title: Target-tenant silent-auth failure
description: abs preview where a silent ARM token for the requested --tenant cannot be obtained without interaction (for example a guest tenant that has not been redeemed, or an expired refresh token). The first ARM read fails with an interaction-required auth error, so preview exits 3 with a tenant-scoped sign-in remediation. Preview is read-only, so no mutation occurs. This replaces the former wrong-token-tenant fixture: both implementations already scope the operational ARM token to --tenant, so a mismatched-token-tenant guard was redundant and only reachable via a fake token — the evergreen behavior is that a target-tenant acquisition either succeeds or fails interaction-required.

json.errorMessage: Could not silently obtain an ARM token for tenant tenant-contoso.
json.remediation: Run `ah auth login --tenant tenant-contoso` with an account that can access that tenant, or correct `--tenant`.
